phase_goal: Make the Inspection Report the canonical engineering artifact for ecommerce evaluation: given a public ecommerce URL, inspect observable discovery surfaces, document evidence and limitations, generate DS1-DS4 reusable datasets, and keep downstream executive or competitor reports dependent on the Inspection Report rather than new site inspection.
expected_deliverable: Local application that runs inspections on different ecommerce websites, helps fix the issues it finds, and generates an executive-ready report showing platform issues, suitable for sending to executive leadership and potential monetization. The Inspection Report remains the canonical evidence artifact the application is built around.

validation_gate.reason: The approved design is frozen in git and the Recommended First Implementation Task is complete: schema contracts, platform self-checks, cache metadata, resume validation, and the Dress Up bounded 5-query pilot with full GEN-012 parity all passed in VAL-051. Implementation changed since VAL-050, so the clean-pass count restarts at one; phase exit needs a second independent pass with no implementation changes plus the GEN-013 BDD inventory refresh.

open_clarifications: Decide raw artifact retention defaults for HTTP, HTML, API payloads, screenshots, and cached evidence. Charter alignment: the local application must re-render executive reports and support fix verification without re-inspecting sites, which favors retaining raw evidence per inspection.

Decide whether Inspection IDs should be timestamp-based or sequential within workspace history. Charter alignment: IDs become user-visible in the application's inspection history and report headers; the implemented timestamp scheme sorts naturally and needs no coordination.

Decide initial Platform Capability maturity threshold required before running broad retailer inspections. Charter alignment: the application promises inspections on different ecommerce websites, so the threshold defines which sites the app can credibly accept per platform type.
